title: HC Sean Payton on the challenge of facing Jacksonville’s defense: 'It’s a really talented front 7’
headline: Payton says Marvin Mims Jr. is set to return punts and kickoffs, but his status for Sunday vs. Jacksonville remains unclear.
summary: Payton said the Broncos are using a recovery-focused schedule after Monday night games, with a Saturday practice that is heavier than normal. He described Jacksonville's defense as well coached and purposeful, especially in generating takeaways from zone coverage and disrupting the ball. He called their front seven very talented and said stopping the run gives any team a balanced foundation. On offense, he said the Broncos need patience against Jacksonville's zones, with ball security required at the catch point. Payton said the Week 1 loss did not go the way anyone wanted and took responsibility for it, and he said Bo Nix's tape review involved many players who felt the same way. On Marvin Mims Jr., Payton said he will return punts and kickoffs, though kickoff usage varies by game plan. When asked whether Mims could miss Sunday, Payton did not give a clear answer. He also said the team is only at the start of its preparation, with the first practice held that day.

injuries.detail: Asked if he is in jeopardy of missing Sunday's game; Payton did not give a clear answer and deflected to the calendar. Mims was hurt later in the prior game.
